THE SCRIPTURES

Rooted in Scripture.

Questions test what the King James Bible explicitly says. Each answer reveals a precise passage reference and a public Scripture link.

This game uses the traditional 80-book KJV collection: 39 Old Testament books, 27 New Testament books, and 14 Apocrypha books. Baruch includes the Letter of Jeremiah; the Song of the Three Holy Children includes the Prayer of Azariah.

Ten passage-reviewed questions per round. Answers are based on the biblical text, not religious traditions.
